partition_definition: n_i_alpha = phase_moles_alpha * X_i_alpha ; P_i_alpha = n_i_alpha / sum_beta n_i_beta (molar; volume-fraction-based partitioning FORBIDDEN)

feature_policy.derived_descriptors_policy: FULL_V1_DERIVED_DESCRIPTORS is post-hoc/diagnostics only, never model input

modeling.tuning: Optuna TPE, seed 20260904, 30 trials, top-2 families per task, DEV_VALIDATION objective
modeling.presence_thresholds: per-label F1-max on DEV_VALIDATION, tie -> closest to 0.5, frozen at DEVELOPMENT_FREEZE
modeling.simplex_projection: clip at 0 then renormalize; sum==0 -> DEV_TRAIN mean simplex (counted); never uses val/test labels
modeling.class_weights: train-only; no SMOTE, no synthetic labels
modeling.bootstrap: composition-level cluster bootstrap, 1000 replicates, seed 20260904, 95% CI
